summary: Handy for people who want to put 0.5” and 1.5” SMRs in the same locations.
specs: Contains four “base” pin nests that can hold a 0.5” SMR. Additionally there is a uniquely crafted 1.5” SMR adapter that fits with fine-tuned precision over the base pin nests, transforming them into a 1.5” SMR target holder.
This larger adapter has three bottom-mounted magnets as well as an air release to make removal from the base adapters easy.
Kits are available in English (541505) or Metric units (541506).
title: 541505 Target Holder with Pins
